About the Role

BBVA is seeking an experienced corporate loan professional to support the growth of its Corporate Lending franchise in China. Based in Shanghai, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in accelerating the origination, structuring, and execution of corporate lending transactions across Mainland China.

Position level (VP or SVP) will be determined based on the selected candidate’s depth of experience and interview assessment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Originate corporate lending opportunities across Mainland China, including syndicated, club, bilateral, sustainable, and event-driven financings.
  • Structure bespoke financing solutions tailored to clients’ strategic objectives, capital structures, and risk profiles.
  • Prepare high-quality pitch books, proposals, and marketing materials to secure mandates and convert opportunities into executed transactions.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, covenants, and security packages with clients.
  • Draft, review, and finalize loan documentation and syndication materials, including term sheets, mandate letters, facility agreements, information memoranda, bank meeting presentations and financial models.
  • Prepare and present comprehensive transaction proposals to business and credit committees, clearly articulating deal structures, key risks, and lending considerations.
  • Take ownership of day-to-day transaction execution, coordinating closely with internal teams (Client Coverage, Loan Syndicate & Sales, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Tax, Sustainable Finance, Markets, and Operations) and external stakeholders (clients, partner banks, and legal counsel) to ensure seamless delivery.
  • Work with senior team members and coach junior team members, fostering high-performance deal execution capabilities and a collaborative team environment.



Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 8+ years of corporate loan origination, structuring and execution experience


Knowledge & Skills

  • Track Record: Proven history of originating, negotiating and executing complex syndicated and bilateral loan mandates in the Chinese market.
  • Technical Expertise: Advanced credit analysis, debt structuring, financial modeling and loan documentation skills.
  • Regulatory & Market Knowledge: Sound understanding of China’s corporate debt market (both onshore and offshore), and relevant regulatory frameworks.
  • Soft Skills: Collaborative team player with outstanding interpersonal and presentation abilities; highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multi-stream transactions under tight timeframes.


Language

  • Native or professional fluency in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken) is required

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - CRM.

Principal responsibilities

Key expectations

  • Demonstrate strong ownership, accountability, and communication.
  • Deliver campaign automation software and tooling as an individual contributor.
  • Apply state-of-the-art AI technologies to solve real business problems.
  • Deliver to tight timelines with high quality and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Take ownership of learning and development in partnership with your line manager.

Job accountabilities

Customer/ Stakeholder

  • Partner with multiple stakeholders to deliver automation toolkit and applications.
  • Build a strong understanding of the business domain, strategy, functional priorities, and required technical capabilities.
  • Drive innovation individually and within the team to deliver incremental business value.
  • Maintain an appropriate level of business and product knowledge.
  • Identify and shape AI-driven opportunities with stakeholders, translating business problems into well-defined AI use cases, success measures, and adoption plans.

Campaign and Project Delivery

  • Translate business needs into actionable tasks, functional and technical requirements, and detailed implementation plan.
  • Deliver high-quality outcomes through effective planning, stakeholder management, and quality controls.
  • Demonstrate strong productivity and reliable delivery.
  • Contribute to measurable team process improvement goals.
  • Design, develop, and integrate AI components into campaign automation solutions, including prototyping, evaluation, and iteration to meet business outcomes.

Process Efficiency and Controls

  • Produce cost-effective code and well-governed documentation; automate repetitive steps to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
  • Implement QA/ QC controls to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.
  • Understand relevant policies and standards, and support leadership in applying them through practical governance for tooling development.

People, Values and Compliance

  • Role-model the Group Values: We Value Difference, We Succeed Together, We Take Responsibility, We Get It Done.
  • Maintain integrity and comply with HSBC standards on conduct, compliance, and Resilience Risk.
  • Complete all required functional and Group/Region-mandated training.
  • Support delivery of functional training where required.

Requirements

Work experience and education requirements

  • Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, CRM, or data analytics, with demonstrable delivery of production-grade applications (full software development lifecycle).
  • PhD or Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

Technical capability

  • Proven end-to-end engineering experience across:
  • Backend services and API development (RESTful design, authentication/authorisation, performance, observability).
  • Front-end UI development (responsive design, component-based frameworks).
  • Data modelling and persistence (SQL design, CRUD patterns, optimisation).
  • Productionisation (CI/CD, environments, monitoring, incident support).
  • Strong programming skills in one or more technology of each space of the following (preferred stack):
  • Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/ or Java (Spring Boot).
  • JavaScript/ TypeScript with React and/ or Vue; solid understanding of web fundamentals including HTML/ CSS and modern application architecture patterns is a plus.
  • SQL databases: PostgreSQL / MySQL/ BigQuery.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  • Develop cross-sell/NBA analytics, including propensity/uplift models, segmentation, eligibility rules and prioritisation logic.
  • Engineer features from CRM and behavioural signals (e.g., digital journeys, RM activities, campaign responses) to improve model performance and interpretability.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Financial Operations Manager.

Business: GCIO COO

Principal Responsibilities

Financial management

  • Manage ASP CTO financials including direct cost booking, recharge review , rate setting and recovery.
  • Ensure timely and accurate cost recognision, complete monthly Cadency reconciliations in line with accounting policy and adherence to operational risk control framework
  • Review direct cost monthly, perform variance analysis, and proactively raise insights, risks and corrective actions.
  • Provide clear executive summaries and management updates, supporting decision-making .
  • Partner with CTO leaders and business managers to provide commercial advice, using operational metrics to improve efficiency and outcomes.
  • Influence stakeholders to implement new policies/guidelines, using strong coordination, negotiation and judgement.

Stakeholder engagement (local customers & global teams)

  • Improve cost transparency and support customers with cost management while managing expectations.
  • Act as the primary Finance interface for China Technology stakeholders, partnering closely with global teams.
  • Coordinate across Finance, Procurement, Vendor Management and CTO teams to deliver end-to-end finance outcomes.
  • Translate finance requirements into practical actions for Technology teams, ensuring alignment to governance, timelines and deliverables.

Local regulatory & governance fulfilment (China)

  • Ensure finance operations meet local statutory/regulatory requirements, including audit readiness and documentation standards.
  • Maintain strong controls in Risk/Compliance to remediate issues on time.
  • Maintain evidence packs and governance artefacts to support audits, inspections and internal reviews.

Wider financial support to ASP markets

  • Play a key role in the China Finance Operations to ensure consistent service delivery across ASP markets.
  • Manage core workflows (e.g., accruals, forecasting, actual vs forecast) to ensure cost booking accuracy and timeliness.
  • Build team capability through standard work, documentation, training and continuous improvement.

Process simplification & continuous improvement

  • Identify pain points, duplication and manual activities across CTO Infrastructure finance processes.
  • Drive simplification, standardisation and automation (where feasible) to improve efficiency, strengthen controls and enhance transparency.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in technology/infrastructure cost management.
  • Demonstrable people leadership experience leading a team.
  • Effective stakeholder leadership and influence across CTO, Finance, Procurement, Vendor Management and global teams; able to translate finance requirements into practical delivery.
  • Solid command of controls, operational risk and China regulatory/governance.
  • Continuous improvement mindset—simplifies and standardises processes, AI and new tools adoption.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Job Description

About the Team

The China AI Platform team will operate with the speed and spirit of a startup, focused on rapidly prototyping and building cutting-edge AI use cases that directly address the critical needs of our businesses in China. The primary goal of this team is to establish the AI platform foundation, demonstrate the transformative potential of AI within the firm, rapidly deliver impactful solutions, and then seamlessly transfer the code, knowledge, and ownership to the respective business and engineering teams. This hands-on engineering role is pivotal in shaping the future of AI adoption at Goldman Sachs China and fostering a culture of innovation and accelerated development.

About The Role

As an AI Platform Specialist, you will be instrumental in identifying, developing, and deploying end-to-end AI/Machine Learning solutions that drive tangible business value; you will work in a fast-paced environment, leveraging your expertise to translate complex business challenges and customer needs into actionable AI architectures and technical specifications, and then implement and deliver these systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Platform Foundation: Lead the engagement with vendors for the establishment of the foundational AI platform to support the rapidly growing demand of AI use cases across China business units.
  • Rapid Prototyping & End-to-End Development: Lead the end-to-end development of AI/ML models and applications, from ideation and data exploration to rapid prototyping and initial deployment.
  • Business Partnership & Solution Architecture: Collaborate closely with business and engineering teams to deeply understand their challenges and customer needs, identify high-impact AI use cases, and translate business requirements into robust technical specifications and solution architectures.
  • Solution Implementation & Delivery: Architect, implement, and deliver scalable, robust, and maintainable AI solutions based on defined technical specifications and architectures, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and workflows within the Goldman Sachs ecosystem.
  • Knowledge Transfer & Enablement: Facilitate effective knowledge transfer through comprehensive documentation, training sessions, mentorship, and pair-programming, empowering receiving teams to take ownership and continue the development of AI solutions.
  • Technology & Innovation Leadership: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and relevant technologies, continuously evaluating and recommending new tools, techniques, and best practices to drive innovation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML or related area, with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end AI solutions in a professional setting.
  • Hands-on experience across the GenAI application stack: from single-agent orchestration (LangChain) and multi-agent collaboration (AgentScope) to low-code platforms (Dify) and enterprise managed services (Amazon Bedrock, Alibaba Model Studio).
  • Demonstrated expertise in building reliable GenAI systems: from RAG and fine-tuning implementation to systematic model quality evaluation.
  • Understand AI risks and be able to design/implement guardrails for safety, accuracy, and compliance.
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, along with relevant AI/ML frameworks.
  • Proven ability to translate complex business requirements and customer needs into well-defined technical architectures and specifications, and to subsequently implement and deliver robust systems based on these designs.
  • Excellent communication capabilities, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a passion for mentoring and enabling others.
  • Proven ability to lead or significantly contribute to cross-functional projects.

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.

The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.

By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.

Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.

HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.

We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.

We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.

To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.

Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.

We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.

Responsibilities Of The Role Holder

  • Execute PM’s placements in the trading books, including hedge trade execution, risk management, price taking and volatility management.
  • Support desk to manage the liquidity risk and good relationship with counterparties.
  • Sharing the market color, popular trading strategies and execute the strategies proved by Team head, preform back-test on hedging trading strategies.
  • Collaborate with analysis on product design and pricing strategy.
  • Demonstrate high professionalism.
  • Understand, follow and demonstrate full compliance with all relevant internal and external regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of HSBC, also in line with the Code of Conduct.
  • Conduct and support BAU where applicable.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • MSc+ Degree in engineering/science/Finance related subject from Chinese/Overseas university.
  • 3 year+ experience on FI products trading and has solid performance record.
  • Strong proficiency in written and spoken Chinese and English.
  • 5-year Working experience in onshore Chinese Fixed Income market.
  • Eligibility to work in mainland China.

Job Summary

This role supports Global Process Owner (GPO), Coverage to manage client lifecycle processes for CIB business. The role sits within first line of defence responsible for adherence to Bank’s policies & procedures, risk management, operational excellence, and governance applicable to the business function.

Key Responsibilities

To support the Global Process Owner / Delegates in executing accountability over process through:

  • Being responsible for the process(es) managed on behalf of the Global Process Owner / Delegate
  • Support Process Owner responsibilities at each stage of the RCSA, from new process and risk identification through to monitoring implement controls, on a minimum of an annual basis or when a trigger event occurs (e.g., a change in control effectiveness)
  • Support ensuring all agreed elevated residual risk actions and treatment plans are completed in a timely manner by all action owners, and logged into the Group OR management system
  • Understand Agile delivery impact on the process: identify risks and dependencies, assess impact on critical processes and residual risk.
  • Discuss, review and approve Change Risk Assessments (where required) and any process impact assessment ahead of change initiatives go-lives, including for “minor” change initiatives

Strategy

  • Responsible for supporting end to end management of CIB, Coverage process governance, risk / controls and regulatory requirements.

Business

  • Work closely with stakeholders internally & externally, including hubs, and across the CIB network to drive a common understanding of policies, procedures and processes.
  • Provide inputs to Policy Owners & Business/Operations while drafting policies & standards as part of Consultation.
  • Engage with Business, Risk Managers, Client Management Heads, Execution Teams and Operations as key stakeholders to build synergy between the regions and countries, share best practices and ensure uniform approach towards implementation of any Global process changes, and adherence to DOIs.
  • Develop operational guidance for issuance to the network as part of any implementation/process change and work with country process owners across CIB to develop training plans & materials across the value chain and prepare the network to implement & support any process change.
  • Conduct Business Performance Reviews to assess effectiveness of execution of the processes.
  • Participate in Coverage Triage to review incoming Business Initiatives and accept changes into the backlog, as appropriate.
  • Refine the process backlog leveraging agile principles including pipeline prioritisation and tracking of initiatives in a timely manner.
  • Where a process gap is identified, perform the gap analysis, design the solution and work with system POs (as applicable), to raise the business requirements.
  • Review the user stories or process improvement suggestions developed for systems, to ensure they capture the business requirements accurately
  • Identify enhancements to improve Client Lifecycle processes/efficiency and/or reduce risk in line with Group Policy and Procedures

Processes

  • Manage end to end Process Governance including revising existing processes and rolling out new ones
  • Work closely with relevant committees, operational risk heads and risk managers to continuously enhance the quality of the guidance issued to the network based on feedback and thematic issues identified through the QA/ RRA processes
  • Work closely with the systems team to identify areas of potential automation
  • Support functional design, testing and deployment of change initiatives
  • Develop a detailed understanding of all areas within the process supported
  • Assist with the roll-out of improved processes and practices, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), User Verification Test (UVT), and BAU Change deployment, as required
  • Manage and engage key stakeholders across client facing divisions, product teams , relevant 2 LOD functions, etc
  • Input into & lead as required relevant squads/working groups
  • Provide subject matter expertise for processes and data managed to support Client Lifecycle BAU and change initiatives
  • Embed new policy and processes into BAU after effectively engage the network

People & Talent

  • Point of contact for resolution of process issues for the processes supported
  • Manage initiatives to improve processes and resolve high profile issues
  • Display strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills on a daily basis in the implementation of process improvements and risk management.
  • Collaborate with other members of the team to ensure governance and coverage of key risk areas and implement the required controls.

Risk Management

  • Timely and effective delivery of reports on regulatory responses and audit management
  • Work closely with Compliance, Legal & Operational Risk teams to ensure deliverables are aligned with the latest requirements & regulations, and any exceptions are appropriately escalated, reported and managed
  • Highlight risks to management and actively monitor them to reduce the likelihood of occurrence. Ongoing control monitoring of the minimum control requirements set out in the policy and procedures to ensure that if a key control activity stops working, or operates outside its normal operating conditions, it will be quickly detected in the ordinary course of line management
  • Attend service review meetings & challenge as necessary to report risk status.
  • Help determine if there are any overlaps & inputs into other processes and/or risk registers
  • Help ensure process risks are identified, escalated & tracked to resolution

Governance

  • Documentation of relevant analysis artefacts as required with Client Life Cycle governance
  • Act as liaison between the 2LoD and the various business or execution teams for effective and efficient process governance.
  • Weighs up benefits of short term tactical and long-term strategic options to ensure solutions are delivered to the appropriate scale, scope and timing

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the teams to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles. Fair Outcome for the Clients, Financial Crime Compliance and Right Environment
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Client Coverage RMT and CMT
  • Operations/Processing Teams
  • Product functions and teams
  • Country Teams
  • Risk & Control functions
  • CIB Data
  • Group CFCR
  • Group Legal
  • Group Operational Risk

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Coverage Operations
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;

Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma qualified with relevant experience in multiple phases of the programme and change management, preferably with exposure to business project delivery roles
  • Knowledge of client onboarding, client lifecycle business areas aligned with corporate and commercial banking
  • Knowledge of SCB standard processes, project management, implementation and post implementation process is an advantage
  • Experience is non-financial risk assessments associated with issues, events and change
  • Experience to senior stakeholder management, regulators and auditors interactions, where required
  • Focused, organised, results-oriented and works independently to strict timeframes
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Commercial Banking (CMB)

HSBC Commercial Banking serves millions of small, medium-sized and middle-market enterprises, providing commercial customers with a full range of banking services including multi-currency business accounts, payments and cash management, wealth management and insurance, and global trade and receivables finance, as well as a comprehensive range of financing solutions. With dedicated Relationship Managers and Business Specialists providing local support and advice in over 60 countries and territories, HSBC helps customers make the most of opportunities for their businesses.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Assist in executing China ecosystem partnership strategies to achieve Business Banking's strategic priorities
  • Assist in partnership engagements, pitches, deal negotiations and related industry analysis to achieve the China partnership strategy in focused sectors
  • Manage partners and internal stakeholders with an agile approach to ensure excellent delivery
  • Coordinate partnership meetings to ensure strategic objectives are achieved and maintained. Mange and nurture excellent relationship with partnerships for long-term collaboration
  • Project management to ensure delivery of projects, POCs, sprint planning, mange partner onboarding and work closely with Customer Intelligence team to deliver projects
  • Responsible for managing partnership risk/ conflict of interests associated with partner selection, contractual relationship and partnership operating model
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders from Global/ Product teams to deliver joint-up propositions
  • Inform on external market trends and current thought leadership, including competitor analysis, identifying potential development opportunities for CMB

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Proven experience in executing strategic partnership opportunities
  • Knowledge of the local Fin-techs/ Banks' digital innovation trend and competition in China
  • Relationship/stakeholder management and influencing skills, excellent interpersonal and communication skills in both mandarin Chinese and English with a proven ability to communicate effectively and confidently at all levels.
  • Commercial banking frontline / Fin-tech working experience in China is an advantage for this role
  • Be curious – Whilst fintech and technology innovation experience is advantageous, an inquisitive and curious mind-set around banking technology and the changing external fintech landscape is a must
  • Demonstrate a focus on execution – components of this role will be new to HSBC and the industry, and a successful candidate will need to influence others with a desire 'to get things done' by key deadlines
  • Project management/ strategy experience is an advantage but not essential

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Job Summary

  • The Head, Expert Knowledge Coach is a Global Centre of Excellence (COE) role responsible for providing enterprise leadership across the Expert Knowledge Coach team, defining and governing how learning, knowledge management, localisation, compliance and risk enablement, and continuous performance improvement are delivered across WRB Contact Centres globally.
  • The role sits alongside the AI Management & Insights COE and the Operations Excellence COE, forming part of the global Contact Centre operating model designed to drive consistent standards, clear accountability and improved service excellence execution across markets.
  • The role acts as a trusted advisor to market and functional leaders on capability uplift, knowledge effectiveness and coaching enablement, ensuring contact centre colleagues have the right skills, content, guidance and interventions to deliver consistent customer, risk and performance excellence. It defines global standards for learning pathways, knowledge content, coaching practices, performance improvement and market localisation, and holds markets accountable for applying these standards consistently. Through leadership of the Expert Knowledge Coach team, it uses data-led insights to identify where learning, knowledge, coaching or process improvement interventions are required to uplift contact centre performance and customer outcomes.
  • The role delivers these outcomes through the leadership, design and governance of global learning and knowledge frameworks informed by appropriate data insights on agent performance and customer experience; oversight of market adherence to global standards; and targeted interventions to address knowledge gaps, capability gaps, conduct risks, customer pain points and recurring performance issues.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Standards and Governance

  • Define and govern global standards, frameworks and ways of working for learning, knowledge management, coaching, localisation and performance improvement across WRB Contact Centres.
  • Establish appropriate leadership practices for team leaders, to ensure appropriate actions regarding quality management practices of human led customer engagement are taken
  • Set clear expectations for market adoption and adherence, ensuring global standards are applied consistently while allowing for local regulatory, customer and operational requirements.
  • Set the direction for role-based learning journeys and capability frameworks that enable consistent customer, risk and performance outcomes.

Knowledge, Capability and Coaching Effectiveness

  • Provide enterprise leadership on knowledge effectiveness, capability uplift and coaching enablement, ensuring colleagues have the skills, content and guidance required to execute consistently.
  • Oversee the strategy for learning and knowledge content, ensuring priorities are informed by customer outcomes, risk themes, market performance trends and operational priorities.
  • Define standards for coaching and improvement interventions, ensuring actions are structured, measurable and focused on sustainable performance uplift.

Risk, Compliance and Performance Enablement

  • Translate risk, conduct and compliance themes into clear learning, knowledge and coaching interventions that support consistent and controlled execution.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Operations Excellence and AI Management & Insights to identify emerging themes, recurring errors and control weaknesses requiring intervention.
  • Ensure enablement activities are embedded into learning pathways, knowledge content and coaching routines, with clear measures of effectiveness, adoption and alignment to conduct, customer and resilience expectations.

Insights-led Continuous Improvement and Market Intervention

  • Use insights from AI, operational performance and customer feedback to identify systemic knowledge, capability, process or execution gaps across markets.
  • Direct targeted interventions where customer, risk or performance outcomes require enterprise support, stronger market accountability or consistent remediation.
  • Track adoption and impact of interventions, ensuring measurable improvement in service quality, customer outcomes, risk management and operational effectiveness.

People and Talent

  • Lead Expert Knowledge Coach by translating enterprise priorities into clear plans, team outcomes, resource priorities and accountable ways of working.
  • Build team capability through coaching, feedback and development, ensuring influence of contact centres in markets, diagnose performance issues and deliver high-impact interventions.
  • Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, strong conduct standards and inclusive leadership, creating a high-performing team culture that supports wellbeing, accountability and continuous improvement.

Risk Management, Governance, Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Lead the function/ team/ business to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients, Effective Financial Markets, Financial Crime Compliance, The Right Environment.

Motivations

  • Energised by setting enterprise direction and building common standards that improve customer experience through knowledge effectiveness, coaching quality and operational execution across global contact centre markets.
  • Motivated by leading a specialist team to influence market adoption, strengthen accountability and translate insight into practical interventions that deliver measurable customer, risk and performance outcomes.
  • Driven by solving systemic issues at scale, using data, judgement and stakeholder influence to improve execution quality, operational resilience and sustainable performance across markets.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Strategic Mindset
  • Enterprise Leadership
  • Knowledge Management
  • Process & Performance Management
  • Quality Assurance & Coaching

Other Skills

  • Customer Experience, Behaviours and Preferences
  • Risk Management
  • Decision Quality
  • Transformation & Problem-Solving

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Leading enterprise standards, capability, knowledge, coaching or performance improvement in complex operational or customer-facing environments.
  • Leading teams and influencing senior stakeholders across markets or functions to drive adoption, accountability and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience using data and judgement to identify systemic gaps and shape interventions that improve execution, controls and performance.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Postgraduate qualification or equivalent professional experience in a relevant discipline.

Languages

  • English

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

  • Define goals and objectives and develop a trading team that builds a cohesive, client centric product offering, and manage officer title distribution
  • Develop and manage the risk and trading infrastructure, including portfolio risk, and ensure risks are correctly represented
  • Coordinate with control functions to ensure compliance with regulations, and partner with Finance to conduct annual financial planning

  • Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Business Analyst.

Business: Group DAO

Principal Responsibilities

The HK Reference Data Business Analyst role is required to deliver accurate, controlled migration of Customer Reference Data to support the delivery of CDMS HK. You’ll work with business and centralised migration execution teams to support migration activities end-to-end (analysis, mapping, cleansing, testing, reconciliation, cutover support), partnering closely with Technology, Operations, Data Owners, and Change teams to ensure data is complete, consistent, and fit for purpose. This is an individual contributor role (G5) with no people management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To

Migration analysis & planning

  • Analyse source-to-target data movements for customer reference/master data domains (e.g., customer identifiers, names, addresses, contact details, tax residency indicators, KYC-related reference attributes).
  • Produce and maintain migration deliverables such as data scope, mapping specifications, transformation rules, data lineage notes, and reconciliation approach.
  • Support estimation and sequencing of migration waves; identify dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early.

Data quality, profiling & remediation

  • Perform data profiling to identify duplicates, missing values, invalid formats, and policy breaches.
  • Define and execute cleansing/remediation steps with Data Owners and upstream teams; track issues to closure.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of data quality controls and repeatable migration playbooks.

Build support (requirements to engineering) & test execution

  • Translate business rules into clear requirements for ETL/configuration teams (or implement lightweight scripts where appropriate).
  • Create test scenarios and test data; execute SIT/UAT support activities focused on data outcomes.
  • Validate transformation logic through evidence-based checks (sampling + automated validations where possible).

Reconciliation, controls & cutover support

  • Run pre- and post-load reconciliations (record counts, key-field checks, exception reports, referential integrity checks).
  • Produce sign-off packs showing migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions with clear risk statements.
  • Support dress rehearsals and cutover weekend activities, including defect triage and rollback considerations.

Governance, risk & documentation

  • Ensure migration activities meet HSBC control expectations (audit trail, approvals, evidence retention, change controls).
  • Escalate risks/issues promptly with options and impact assessment.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation that can be understood by stakeholders across Hong Kong and global teams.

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Work effectively with Technology, Data Governance, Operations, Compliance/Financial Crime teams, and programme change resources.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions clearly—especially when trade-offs arise (time vs. quality vs. scope).

Key stakeholders

  • Technology (data engineering/ETL, application teams, testers)
  • Data Owners/Data Stewards
  • Operations/Customer Services teams (where data is originated/maintained)
  • Change/Programme Management
  • Risk & Compliance/Financial Crime (where data impacts controls and screening outcomes)

Requirements

  • Proven experience (typically 3–6 years) as a business and data analyst or similar in a complex, regulated environment (financial services preferred), working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
  • SQL (or equivalent) capability for data extraction, reconciliation and data analysis tasks.
  • Solid understanding of data quality management (profiling, controls, issue root-cause analysis) and working knowledge of data governance concepts (lineage, metadata, critical data elements).
  • Experience translating business requirements into analytical outputs (KPIs, metrics definitions, reporting packs), including documenting requirements and assumptions.
  • Exposure to reference/master data concepts and operating model practices (e.g., data standards, domain ownership, stewardship) is desirable.
  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working (user stories, sprint ceremonies) and collaborating effectively across business, operations and technology teams.
  • Strong communication skills: able to explain complex data findings clearly, challenge constructively, and influence outcomes with evidence.
  • Degree (or equivalent experience) in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics) or demonstrable applied analytical capability.
  • Experience working with operational teams to understand, map and improve end-to-end processes (e.g., SIPOC/process mapping), identifying data pain points, control gaps and opportunities for simplification/automation.
  • Proven involvement in data migration activities (e.g., legacy-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation rules, reconciliation and post-migration validation), supporting cutover readiness and hypercare where required.
  • Working knowledge of process change governance (impacts, risks, controls, training/adoption considerations) and how process changes affect upstream/downstream data flows and reporting.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
